name: GNC Energy / DC Korea Dangjin Seokmun National Industrial Complex AI Data Center
notes: Chungnam, Dangjin, GNC Energy and DC Korea signed an MOU for a KRW 2 trillion AI data center in Seokmun National Industrial Complex; reported floor area 72,885 sq m on 33,673 sq m site, completion/investment through 2031, about 200 local jobs. MW capacity not disclosed in accessible source.

name: NFD Korea Dangjin 300MW AI Data Center Campus
notes: Company announcement says NFD Korea is developing a 300 MW AI-ready campus in Dangjin with site secured, power contract and building permits completed; phase 1 Ready-for-Service target is Q1 2028.

name: Geumsan Daejeon IDC / Data Center Site
notes: Local press describes Geumsan-gun as a leading data-center municipality and search-discoverable investment material markets a Daejeon IDC site in Geumsan; accessible public details on developer, capacity and construction status are limited.

name: National Information Resources Service Gongju Backup / Disaster Recovery Center
developer: National Information Resources Service / Ministry of the Interior and Safety
notes: Government backup/disaster-recovery data center in Gongju; MOIS/MBC/Kyunghyang reporting says online/offline backup systems from NIRS Daejeon, Gwangju and Daegu were moved to Gongju and began operation on 2025-10-01, with MOIS inspection on 2025-10-24.

name: Naepo New Town AI Data Center MOU
developer: Mission Critical Engineering; Msys; ehostICT SPC
notes: Hongseong-gun announced an MOU for a private commercial AI data center in Naepo Urban Advanced Industrial Complex, on a 14,130 sq m site with KRW 270 billion investment; later construction status not confirmed in searched sources.
